# Problem Description
 
Describe the problem or limitation you are experiencing.
 
Examples:
 
- OCR does not support my language.
- Markdown output is difficult to read.
- The application cannot process a specific file type.
- The current workflow requires too many manual steps.
 
Why is this a problem?
 
---
 
# Proposed Solution
 
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented.
 
Please be as specific as possible.
 
Examples:
 
- Add drag-and-drop support.
- Add support for EPUB conversion.
- Add OCR language auto-detection.
- Add export to JSON format.
- Add integration with AI/RAG workflows.
 
---
 
# Alternative Solutions Considered
 
Describe any alternative approaches, workarounds, or existing tools you have considered.
 
Examples:
 
- Using another OCR tool.
- Running an external script.
- Using a different Markdown converter.
- Manual processing.
 
---
 
# Expected Benefits
 
How would this feature improve the user experience?
 
Examples:
 
- Faster document processing.
- Better OCR accuracy.
- Reduced manual work.
- Improved Markdown quality.
- Better support for AI knowledge bases.
 
---
 
# Use Case
 
Describe your real-world use case.
 
Examples:
 
- Personal knowledge management.
- Legal document processing.
- Research workflows.
- AI / RAG pipelines.
- Digital archiving.
- Enterprise documentation.
 
---
 
# Additional Context
 
Provide any additional context, references, screenshots, mockups, sample documents, or examples that may help explain the request.
 
You may also include links to similar implementations or related projects.
 
---
 
# Checklist
 
Before submitting this feature request, please confirm:
 
- [ ] I searched existing Issues and Discussions.
- [ ] This feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I clearly described the problem being solved.
- [ ] I explained the expected benefit.
- [ ] I provided relevant context when available.
